                                                                  ∀ (v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                    (G :

                                                                  (∀ (v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)

                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsClassField c.order c.centre →

                                          (∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion,

                                                (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                    MeasureTheory.MemLp (c.modelActuator i) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧

                                                      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (c.modelActuatorGrad i)

                                                            (fun y =>

                                                            MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                          ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.modelActuatorGrad i y = 0) →
                                                    (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (c.modelPinField i)
                                                            MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                          MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                              (fun y =>
                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.modelPinField i y))
                                                              MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                            ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.modelPinField i y = 0) →

                                                                (fun y =>

                                                                MeasureTheory.volume) →

                                                          (∀ (i : Fin k), ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.pin i y = 0) →
                                                            (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                                                                ∀ (v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                  (G :

                                                                      Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                                                                  (H :

                                                                      Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                        Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
                                                                  Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsSecondOrderField c.order v G
                                                                      H →
                                                                    (Breakdown.SteadyCert.l2Norm fun y =>
                                                                        2 •
                                                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.symProduct
                                                                            (fun z => c.profile p z - c.centre z)
                                                                            (fun z =>
                                                                              c.gradProfile p z - c.centreGrad z)
                                                                            v G y) ≤
                                                                      c.centreLoss * √(c.energy G H)) →
                                                              (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                                                                  ∀ (v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                    (G :
                                                                      Breakdown.Space →
                                                                        Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                                                                    (H :
                                                                      Breakdown.Space →
                                                                        Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                          Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
                                                                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsSecondOrderField c.order v G
                                                                        H →
                                                                      (c.rows fun y =>
                                                                          (c.rotationRate p - c.modelRate) •
                                                                            ((G y) (Breakdown.axialTurn y) -
                                                                              Breakdown.axialTurn (v y))) ≤
                                                                        c.rateLoss * √(c.energy G H)) →
                                                                (∀ (y u : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                    inner ℝ u ((c.strainError y) u) ≤
                                                                      c.strainLoss * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                                                                  (∀ (v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                      (G :
                                                                        Breakdown.Space →
                                                                          Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                                                                      (H :
                                                                        Breakdown.Space →
                                                                          Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                            Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
                                                                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsSecondOrderField c.order v
                                                                          G H →
                                                                        √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                              ‖c.curlGradError y‖ ^ 2 * ‖v y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                          c.curlGradLoss *
                                                                            √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (G y))) →
                                                                    (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                        √(c.cellWeight y) * ‖c.velocityError y‖ ≤
                                                                          c.velocityLoss) →
                                                                      (∀ (v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                          (G :
                                                                            Breakdown.Space →
                                                                              Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                                                                          (H :
                                                                            Breakdown.Space →
                                                                              Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
                                                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsSecondOrderField
                                                                              c.order v G H →
                                                                            √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                  c.cellWeight y * ‖c.curlError y‖ ^ 2 *
                                                                                    ‖v y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                              c.curlLoss *
                                                                                √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                      (G y))) →
                                                                        ∑ i,
                                                                              ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                  (c.actuatorGrad i y -
                                                                                    c.modelActuatorGrad i y) ≤
                                                                            c.actuatorGradLoss ^ 2 →
                                                                          ∑ i,
                                                                                (c.rows fun y =>
                                                                                    c.actuator i y -
                                                                                      c.modelActuator i y) ^
                                                                                  2 ≤
                                                                              c.actuatorLoss ^ 2 →
                                                                            ∑ i,
                                                                                  ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                      (c.pin i y -
                                                                                        c.modelPinField i y) ≤
                                                                                c.pinFieldLoss ^ 2 →
                                                                              0 ≤ c.centreLoss ∧
                                                                                  0 ≤ c.rateLoss ∧
                                                                                    0 ≤ c.strainLoss ∧
                                                                                      0 ≤ c.curlGradLoss ∧
                                                                                        0 ≤ c.velocityLoss ∧
                                                                                          0 ≤ c.curlLoss ∧
                                                                                            0 ≤ c.actuatorGradLoss ∧
                                                                                              0 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ∧
                                                                                                0 ≤ c.pinFieldLoss →
                                                                                c.centreLoss +
                                                                                        (c.strainLoss +
                                                                                            √(7 / 2) * c.curlGradLoss) /
                                                                                          c.weightMin +
                                                                                      c.actuatorGradLoss /
                                                                                        (2 * c.multiplierScale *
                                                                                          √c.weightMin) ≤
                                                                                    c.potLoss →
                                                                                  √c.rowMax * c.centreLoss +
                                                                                            c.rateLoss +
                                                                                          (c.velocityLoss +
                                                                                              c.curlLoss) /
                                                                                            √c.weightMin +
                                                                                        c.actuatorLoss /
                                                                                          c.multiplierScale ≤
                                                                                      c.rowLoss →
                                                                                    c.pinFieldLoss / √c.weightMin ≤
                                                                                        c.pinLoss →
                                                                                      (∀ (a b : Fin N),

                                                                                              c.blockIndex b →
                                                                                            c.rowWeight a =
                                                                                              c.rowWeight b) →
                                                                                        0 ≤ c.baseCoef →
                                                                                          (∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount),
                                                                                              0 ≤ c.levelCoef i) →
                                                                                            (∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount),
                                                                                                0 < c.levelRate i) →
                                                                                              c.splitVisc ^
                                                                                                    (1 / (α - 1)) ≤
                                                                                                  c.cutoff →
                                                                                                (∀ (x : ℝ),
                                                                                                    0 < x →
                                                                                                      x ≤ c.cutoff →
                                                                                                        c.ratioSymbol α
                                                                                                            x ≤
                                                                                                          c.levelSum
                                                                                                            x) →
                                                                                                  ⋯

      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), e.radiusMin ≤ e.radius y ∧ e.radius y ≤ e.radiusMax) →
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 < t → e.radius (t • y) = e.radius y) →

                  Measurable e.strainBound →

                        ∀ (u : Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ ((c.centreStrain y) u) u ≤ e.strainBound y * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                      (∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, ‖c.centreCurlGrad y‖ ≤ e.meanCurlGradBound y + e.waveCurlGradBound y) →
                        (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ e.meanCurlGradBound y) →
                          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ e.waveCurlGradBound y) →

    {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →

        (t : Breakdown.CellCert.FinalChain.IsCellRest α c) →
          ((base : Breakdown.CellCert.IsFracCertBase α c.toFracCertData) →
              (innerWeight_nonneg : 0 ≤ c.innerWeight) →
                (innerWeight_le : c.innerWeight ≤ c.splitVisc) →
                  (cellRegion_measurable : MeasurableSet c.cellRegion) →
                    (cellRegion_bounded : Bornology.IsBounded c.cellRegion) →
                      (cellRegion_class :
                          ∀ y ∈ c.cellRegion,
                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.turnStep c.order y ∈ c.cellRegion ∧
                              Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y ∈ c.cellRegion) →
                        (cellWeight_measurable : Measurable c.cellWeight) →
                          (cellWeight_nonneg : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ c.cellWeight y) →
                            (cellWeight_le : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), c.cellWeight y ≤ c.rowMax) →
                              (cellWeight_support : ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.cellWeight y = 0) →
                                (rows_dominated :
                                    ∀ (F : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                      MeasureTheory.MemLp F 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                                        c.rows F ^ 2 ≤ ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), c.cellWeight y * ‖F y‖ ^ 2) →
                                  (row_in_cells : ∀ (a : Fin N), ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.row a y = 0) →
                                    (centre_smooth : ContDiff ℝ 1 c.centre) →
                                      (centre_second :
                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakSecondDerivOf c.centreGrad c.centreSecond ∧
                                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable c.centreSecond MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                        (centre_divergence :
                                            ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt c.centre y = 0) →
                                          (centre_class : Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsClassField c.order c.centre) →
                                            (centre_bounds :
                                                ∃ C,
                                                  ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                    ‖c.centre y‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-1) ∧
                                                      ‖c.centreGrad y‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2) ∧
                                                        ‖c.centreSecond y‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-3)) →
                                              (model_measurable :
                                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable c.modelVelocity
                                                      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable c.modelCurl
                                                        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable c.modelStrain
                                                          MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable c.modelCurlGrad
                                                          MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                (model_bounded :
                                                    ∃ C,
                                                      ∀ y ∈ c.cellRegion,
                                                        ‖c.modelVelocity y‖ ≤ C ∧
                                                          ‖c.modelCurl y‖ ≤ C ∧
                                                            ‖c.modelStrain y‖ ≤ C ∧ ‖c.modelCurlGrad y‖ ≤ C) →
                                                  (model_in_cells :
                                                      ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.modelVelocity y = 0 ∧ c.modelCurl y = 0) →
                                                    (model_outside :
                                                        ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion,
                                                          c.modelStrain y = c.centreStrain y ∧
                                                            c.modelCurlGrad y = c.centreCurlGrad y) →
                                                      (modelStrain_symmetric :
                                                          ∀ (y u w : Breakdown.Space),
                                                            inner ℝ ((c.modelStrain y) u) w =
                                                              inner ℝ u ((c.modelStrain y) w)) →
                                                        (modelCurlGrad_trace :
                                                            ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                              ∑ i, Breakdown.CellCert.entry (c.modelCurlGrad y) i i =
                                                                0) →
                                                          (modelActuator_data :
                                                              ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                MeasureTheory.MemLp (c.modelActuator i) 2
                                                                    MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                                  ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.modelActuator i y = 0) →
                                                            (modelActuatorGrad_data :
                                                                ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                                      (c.modelActuatorGrad i) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                                        (fun y =>
                                                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                            (c.modelActuatorGrad i y))
                                                                        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                                      ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.modelActuatorGrad i y = 0) →
                                                              (modelPin_data :
                                                                  ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                                        (c.modelPinField i) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                                      MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                                          (fun y =>
                                                                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                              (c.modelPinField i y))
                                                                          MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                                        ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.modelPinField i y = 0) →
                                                                (actuator_gradient :
                                                                    ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf
                                                                          (c.actuator i) (c.actuatorGrad i) ∧
                                                                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
                                                                            (c.actuatorGrad i) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                                          MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                                            (fun y =>
                                                                              Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                (c.actuatorGrad i y))
                                                                            MeasureTheory.volume) →
                                                                  (actuator_in_cells :
                                                                      ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                        ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.actuator i y = 0) →
                                                                    (pin_in_cells :
                                                                        ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                                          ∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion, c.pin i y = 0) →
                                                                      (centreLoss_bound :
                                                                          ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                                                                            ∀ (v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                              (G :
                                                                                Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                  Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                                                                              (H :
                                                                                Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                  Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space),
                                                                              Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsSecondOrderField
                                                                                  c.order v G H →
                                                                                (Breakdown.SteadyCert.l2Norm fun y =>
                                                                                    2 •
                                                                                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.symProduct
                                                                                        (fun z =>
                                                                                          c.profile p z - c.centre z)
                                                                                        (fun z =>
                                                                                          c.gradProfile p z -
                                                                                            c.centreGrad z)
                                                                                        v G y) ≤
                                                                                  c.centreLoss * √(c.energy G H)) →
                                                                        (rateLoss_bound :
                                                                            ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                                                                              ∀ (v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                                (G :
                                                                                  Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space)
                                                                                (H :
                                                                                  Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                        Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsSecondOrderField
                                                                                    c.order v G H →
                                                                                  (c.rows fun y =>
                                                                                      (c.rotationRate p - c.modelRate) •
                                                                                        ((G y) (Breakdown.axialTurn y) -
                                                                                          Breakdown.axialTurn (v y))) ≤
                                                                                    c.rateLoss * √(c.energy G H)) →
                                                                          (strainLoss_bound :
                                                                              ∀ (y u : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                inner ℝ u ((c.strainError y) u) ≤
                                                                                  c.strainLoss * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                                                                            (curlGradLoss_bound :
                                                                                ∀
                                                                                  (v :
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                                                                                  (G :
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                        Breakdown.Space)
                                                                                  (H :
                                                                                    Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                      Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                        Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                          Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                  Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsSecondOrderField
                                                                                      c.order v G H →
                                                                                    √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                          ‖c.curlGradError y‖ ^ 2 *
                                                                                            ‖v y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                                      c.curlGradLoss *
                                                                                        √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                              (G y))) →
                                                                              (velocityLoss_bound :
                                                                                  ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                    √(c.cellWeight y) *
                                                                                        ‖c.velocityError y‖ ≤
                                                                                      c.velocityLoss) →
                                                                                (curlLoss_bound :
                                                                                    ∀
                                                                                      (v :
                                                                                        Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                          Breakdown.Space)
                                                                                      (G :
                                                                                        Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                          Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                            Breakdown.Space)
                                                                                      (H :
                                                                                        Breakdown.Space →
                                                                                          Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                            Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ]
                                                                                              Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsSecondOrderField
                                                                                          c.order v G H →
                                                                                        √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                              c.cellWeight y * ⋯ ^ 2 *
                                                                                                ‖v y‖ ^ 2) ≤
                                                                                          c.curlLoss *
                                                                                            √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                                  (G y))) →
                                                                                  (actuatorGradLoss_bound :
                                                                                      ∑ i,
                                                                                          ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                              (c.actuatorGrad i y -
                                                                                                c.modelActuatorGrad i
                                                                                                  y) ≤
                                                                                        c.actuatorGradLoss ^ 2) →
                                                                                    (actuatorLoss_bound :
                                                                                        ∑ i,
                                                                                            (c.rows fun y =>
                                                                                                c.actuator i y -
                                                                                                  c.modelActuator i y) ^
                                                                                              2 ≤
                                                                                          c.actuatorLoss ^ 2) →
                                                                                      (pinFieldLoss_bound :
                                                                                          ∑ i,
                                                                                              ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                                  (c.pin i y -
                                                                                                    c.modelPinField i
                                                                                                      y) ≤
                                                                                            c.pinFieldLoss ^ 2) →
                                                                                        (losses_nonneg' :
                                                                                            0 ≤ c.centreLoss ∧
                                                                                              0 ≤ c.rateLoss ∧
                                                                                                0 ≤ c.strainLoss ∧
                                                                                                  0 ≤ c.curlGradLoss ∧
                                                                                                    0 ≤ c.velocityLoss ∧
                                                                                                      0 ≤ c.curlLoss ∧
                                                                                                        0 ≤
                                                                                                            c.actuatorGradLoss ∧
                                                                                                          0 ≤
                                                                                                              c.actuatorLoss ∧
                                                                                                            0 ≤
                                                                                                              c.pinFieldLoss) →
                                                                                          (potLoss_ge :
                                                                                              c.centreLoss +
                                                                                                    (c.strainLoss + ⋯) /
                                                                                                      c.weightMin +
                                                                                                  c.actuatorGradLoss /
                                                                                                    (2 *
                                                                                                        c.multiplierScale *
                                                                                                      √c.weightMin) ≤
                                                                                                c.potLoss) →
                                                                                            (rowLoss_ge :
                                                                                                √c.rowMax *
                                                                                                          c.centreLoss +
                                                                                                        c.rateLoss +
                                                                                                      (c.velocityLoss +
                                                                                                          c.curlLoss) /
                                                                                                        √c.weightMin +
                                                                                                    c.actuatorLoss /
                                                                                                      c.multiplierScale ≤
                                                                                                  c.rowLoss) →
                                                                                              (pinLoss_ge :
                                                                                                  c.pinFieldLoss /
                                                                                                      √c.weightMin ≤
                                                                                                    c.pinLoss) →
                                                                                                (rowWeight_block :
                                                                                                    ∀ (a b : Fin N),
                                                                                                      c.blockIndex a =
                                                                                                          c.blockIndex
                                                                                                            b →
                                                                                                        c.rowWeight a =
                                                                                                          c.rowWeight
                                                                                                            b) →
                                                                                                  (baseCoef_nonneg :
                                                                                                      0 ≤ c.baseCoef) →
                                                                                                    (levelCoef_nonneg :
                                                                                                        ∀
                                                                                                          (i :
                                                                                                            Fin
                                                                                                              c.levelCount),
                                                                                                          0 ≤
                                                                                                            c.levelCoef
                                                                                                              i) →
                                                                                                      ⋯) →
            motive t

                  MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • L y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                    (Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf (A.dualFieldOf P j p) fun y =>
                        fderiv ℝ (A.dualFieldOf P j p) y) ∧

                          MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
            (∃ L,
                (Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf (A.potentialFieldOf P j p) fun y =>
                    fderiv ℝ (A.potentialFieldOf P j p) y) ∧
                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf (A.potentialFieldOf P j p) L ∧

                Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakMatrixDivergenceOf (A.fluxFieldOf P j p) Dv ∧
